entities.summary: Krzysztof Marek Piesiewicz is a Polish lawyer, politician and screenwriter for film. From 1991 to 1993 and from 1997 to 2011 he was a member of Polish Senate. He was the head of the Social Movement (RS) or Social Movement Party.
